# Zeeshan Ali Khan

> Senior Software Engineer & Conversational AI Engineer in Berlin, building voice and chat AI agents that handle real customer conversations — backed by 12+ years of real-time contact center and telephony systems.

## About

Zeeshan Ali Khan is a Senior Software Engineer and Conversational AI Engineer based in Berlin, Germany. He builds production voice and chat AI agents (LLMs, speech-to-text, text-to-speech) on top of deep telephony and contact-center experience. He understands both sides of a voice agent: the AI and the telephony it runs on.

## Quick facts

- **Location:** Berlin, Germany
- **Current role:** Senior Software Engineer, virtualQ (Nov 2024 – Present)
- **Experience:** 12+ years (since June 2014)
- **Education:** BS Computer Science, FAST-NUCES Lahore (2010–2014)
- **Email:** ZeeshanAliKhan15@gmail.com
